data.one_liner: Scroll observer to jump or animate to indices in scroll views without breaking current widgets.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to scroll to specific indices or ratios in ListView, GridView, CustomScrollView, and SingleChildScrollView. It also provides visibility checking for items and scroll offset retention physics.
use_when: You need to programmatically jump or animate to a specific index in a list or grid.
You want to check if a specific item index is currently visible on screen.
You need to retain scroll position when adding items to the top of a list.
avoid_when: You are using NestedScrollView, which is not yet supported.
You are not willing to wrap item widgets inside an ObserverProxy.
strengths: Supports a wide range of scroll views including ListView, GridView, CustomScrollView, SingleChildScrollView, and ListWheelScrollView.
Provides utilities for checking visible items and visibility ratios.
Includes PositionRetainedScrollPhysics for retaining scroll offsets.
weaknesses: Requires every observed item widget or builder to be wrapped using ObserverProxy.
NestedScrollView is currently untested and not supported.
